description: Grady says the clonejackers working the strip south of the Embassy are killing his business by killing his customers. Clear two of them out and bring back the flashlight cells they lifted off him.
name: The First Hour

objectives.desc: Head down Ironside — south past the Embassy — to where the clonejackers work (follow the green GPS line — hit AUTO).
emotes: {who} heads down Ironside, past the Embassy's warm lights, toward the clonejackers' patch.

objectives.desc: Put down 2 clonejackers preying on the newborns.
emotes: {who} drives a clonejacker back a step.

objectives.desc: Loot Grady's stolen cells off a downed clonejacker.
